hero.title: One log, two sides.
hero.lead: GymTrack is a training log for athletes and their coaches. Workouts, meals, and measurements live in one place, so both sides work from the same record.

product.label: Product
product.title: Five parts, one record.
product.lead: Each part is a plain list you can read in a few seconds.
product.item1_body: Log every set with load, reps, and rest. Exercises come from a shared catalog, so both sides use the same names.
product.item2_body: Record what you ate and when it happened. Meals are added and read, never quietly rewritten.
product.item3_body: Weight, body fat, and body measurements over time, with charts that show the trend instead of a single number.
product.item4_body: Connect with a coach through an invite code. Your history, your plans, and your coach's feedback stay in one place.
product.item5_body: Coaches build workout plans and assign them. Follow a plan or log a session on your own.

roles.title: Two ways to use it
roles.athlete_body: Keep the log, see the plan, and get feedback on the entry itself instead of a message thread.
roles.athlete_1: Fast logging for sets, meals, and measurements
roles.athlete_2: Charts that show the real trend over weeks
roles.athlete_3: One place for coach feedback and assigned plans
roles.trainer_body: See the work as it happened and change the plan with the data in front of you.
roles.trainer_1: A client list with activity and progress
roles.trainer_2: Comments on the exact entry, not a separate thread
roles.trainer_3: Workout plans you assign and update

method.title: How the loop works
method.lead: Three steps, one direction. If a step is missing, the coaching turns into guesswork.
method.step1_body: The athlete records the session while the details are still fresh.
method.step2_body: The coach reads the entry and leaves feedback on that entry.
method.step3_body: The plan changes based on what the log shows, not on what was planned in advance.

faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Common questions
faq.q1: Do I need a coach to use GymTrack?
faq.a1: No. Log on your own and invite a coach whenever you want a second opinion. A coaching relationship is always your choice.
faq.q2: Can I edit what I log?
faq.a2: Workouts can be edited or deleted within 24 hours of logging. Body measurements stay editable for 7 days. Meals are added and read only.
faq.q3: How do I connect with a trainer?
faq.a3: A trainer can send you an invite code, or you can send a coaching request to a trainer you found. Once either side accepts, you share the same log.
faq.a4: Only the entries you share: workouts, meals, measurements, and comments. Nothing is published.
faq.q5: Do I need a workout plan?
faq.a5: No. Plans are optional. A coach can assign one, but you can also log sessions on your own.
faq.a6: English and Turkish. The interface follows the language you choose.
